connectors.name: AniKoto
connectors.releaseNotes: Restores stream resolution using MegaPlay's current source endpoint. Preserves SUB/DUB selection, subtitle mappings, existing AniKoto identity and the existing connector schema. No app update or JavaScript runtime is introduced by this module change.

connectors.name: AniKage (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Prioritized healthy neko stream provider over dead megg/koto origins. Added bibiemb.xyz and bakayaro.live mirrors. Validated HLS playback across sub and dub.

connectors.name: AnimeGG
connectors.releaseNotes: Declares honest per-episode Sub and Dub availability so unavailable audio is disabled before playback.

connectors.name: Update Flow Test
connectors.releaseNotes: Version 1.0.0 for validating Aroki's signed source-update flow.

connectors.name: One Pace
connectors.releaseNotes: M25: Consolidates One Pace into a single stable title on discovery and search. Increases concurrency to 4 workers and raises timeout to 30s so all 485+ episodes across all arcs load smoothly.

connectors.name: Synthetiq One
connectors.releaseNotes: Engineering opt-in connector v1.2.11 for the owner-operated Synthetiq One API. Adds the currently returned cdn.watching.onl and s1.akirax.buzz HLS hosts; native API-only search, details, episodes, discovery and DUB playback remain unchanged. No JavaScript, WebView or VPS changes.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Anime
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.38+. Native catalogue and fresh Flow/Zuri stream resolution. Basic owner-device playback and seeking have been demonstrated. Provider Dub/audio mismatches and missing captions remain possible; broad language and offline certification are incomplete. Existing source identity is preserved.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Flux
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.38+. Basic playback and seeking have been demonstrated. Catalogue-derived episode counts are not provider-verified. Broad spoken-language, caption and offline certification remain incomplete. Downloads remain disabled. Not compatible with Aroki 1.2.

connectors.name: AniWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.36+. Home/Browse discovery and native playback resolver are unchanged. Sub-only: German-subtitle mirror first, English-subtitle fallback; German Dub is not included. Visible captions, spoken language and offline remain unverified.

connectors.name: Anime-Sama
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.36+. Native panel, ordinal episode, Sibnet and literal Ansembed support. Playback and seeking have been demonstrated on selected titles; some routes, including the previously sampled Black Torch middle episode, may time out. Full device, language and offline certification remain incomplete.
